item.title: MacArthur Center in Norfolk to close in June for redevelopment
item.description: The MacArthur Center is slated to close in late June, according to the city of Norfolk.

item.title: Teen injured in Chesapeake firearm incident
item.description: A juvenile was injured in a firearm incident in Chesapeake, Virginia on Saturday night, and was transported to a local hospital for further treatment, with authorities believing the incident to be an isolated event.

item.title: Dominion Energy: Thousands of power outages across Hampton Roads due to high winds
item.description: Dominion Energy is working to restore power to over 29,000 residents in Hampton Roads who have been affected by high winds, and is encouraging customers to continue reporting outages to help crews locate trouble spots.

item.title: Victim Identified in Davidson Street Shooting: NPD
item.description: A man is dead after a shooting on Davidson Street in Norfolk Saturday morning, according to the Norfolk Police Department.

item.title: Winter weather delays Carnival Sunshine's return to Norfolk
item.description: The Carnival Sunshine cruise ship's return to the Port of Norfolk has been delayed due to weather, according to an advisory Carnival Cruise Line sent to guests.
